headline: I can't stop working yet. What's still blocking my money?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see him, but your hand found the card where nothing has stopped working.
Both hands are occupied, and every tool stays out on the table.
You said you cannot stop working yet and asked what blocks your money. What catches me is that neither hand is resting.
The work continues, and the money is still blocked.
Something meets the work right where the result should follow. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The card was hidden, yet you chose the one held by one small thing.
Look at the rope. It circles one ankle, and no other part is tied.
You asked what is still blocking the money. This card keeps my eye on that single rope.
Still, the money has not moved, though only one point holds the picture.
There's something between the work and the money. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding the money…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs told you nothing, but your hand went to the one travelling light.
Look at the small bundle on his stick. That is all he is carrying.
You asked why you still cannot stop working. The light bundle on this card holds my attention.
And yet your work keeps going while the money does not move with it.
What has hold of the result keeps it separate from the work you keep doing. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of the result…
